svg.title: Portfolio composition: languages, engineering stack, AI and Agentic AI
svg.desc: Four proportional doughnut charts with values and legends. Language percentages measure unique source-file bytes. Other percentages measure the share of selected documented repository-topic matches. Repositories can appear in multiple categories. These are evidence counts, not skill scores. Snapshot of 23 public project repositories, 14 November 2026.
